SELECT DISTINCT e."name", e."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE e."event_space" LIKE '%Banquet Hall%'
   OR e."event_space" LIKE '%Conference Room%'
GROUP BY e."name", e."event_space", e."capacity"
HAVING CAST(e."capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200;
3:
SELECT DISTINCT
    "r"."name" AS restaurant_name,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER("r"."food_service") LIKE '%cafe%' THEN 'Café'
        WHEN LOWER("r"."food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%' THEN 'Restaurant'
    END AS service_type
FROM
    "restaurants" "r"
WHERE
    LOWER("r"."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
4:
SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" LIKE '%Café%'
    OR r."cuisine" LIKE '%Italian%'
6:
SELECT DISTINCT "s"."name" AS "staff_name", "s"."role"
FROM "staff" "s"
WHERE LOWER("s"."role") LIKE '%chef%'
   OR (LOWER("s"."role") LIKE '%server%' AND LOWER("s"."language") LIKE '%english%')
ORDER BY "s"."role", "s"."name";
8:
SELECT DISTINCT s."name" AS chef_name
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(s."role") LIKE '%chef%'
  AND LOWER(s."language") LIKE '%english%'

UNION ALL


SELECT DISTINCT s1."name" || ' speaks ' || s1."language" AS server_language
FROM "staff" s1
WHERE LOWER(s1."role") LIKE '%server%'

INTERSECT


SELECT DISTINCT s2."name" || ' speaks ' || s2."language" AS server_language
FROM "staff" s2
WHERE LOWER(s2."role") LIKE '%server%'
  AND s2."language" IN (
      SELECT s3."language"
      FROM "staff" s3
      WHERE LOWER(s3."role") LIKE '%server%'
      GROUP BY s3."language"
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  );
111:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
112:
WITH internship_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "internshipid") AS total_internships
    FROM "internships"
),
responsibility_coverage AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS covered_internships
    FROM "responsibilities" r
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY r."responsibility"
)
SELECT DISTINCT r."responsibility"
FROM responsibility_coverage r
JOIN internship_count ic ON r."covered_internships" = ic."total_internships";
113:
SELECT DISTINCT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."id";
114:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_name";
261:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "salary"
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
JOIN
    max_salary_job msj ON j."jobid" = msj."jobid";
263:
SELECT DISTINCT sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "salarydetails" sd
JOIN "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%';
264:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
